sources.text: Sen Lab Sen Lab is interested in understanding the molecular mechanisms governing stem cell self-renewal, differentiation, and progression to neoplasia. About Sen Lab about Sen Lab Research Focus The Sen Lab is interested in understanding the molecular mechanisms governing stem cell self-renewal, differentiation, and progression to neoplasia. We use human epithelial tissue as a model system because of the ability to regenerate the organ on immune deficient mice. Check out Sen Lab publications About Dr. George Sen Dr. George Sen is a Professor of Cellular and Molecular Medicine and Dermatology at UC San Diego. Dr. Sen's research has been focused on understanding the molecular mechanisms of epidermal stem cell self-renewal and differentiation. Read more about our research Principal Investigator George Sen, Ph.D. Chief of the Division of Epithelial Biology Professor of Cellular and Molecular Medicine Professor of Dermatology Phone: 858-246-0268 Email: gsen@ucsd.edu People Meet the team Contact Us Get in touch Join the Lab Applicants interested in joining the lab can email Dr. George Sen .
